target.title: fix: detect localized Windows netstat listeners
target.body:
Closes #99984

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users on localized Windows installs could run gateway `--force` or port diagnostics and have OpenClaw miss an active TCP listener because Windows `netstat` did not print the English `LISTENING` state text.

## Why This Change Was Made

The CLI force-free path and the infra diagnostics path now share one Windows TCP `netstat` listener parser. It matches listener rows by TCP shape, exact local endpoint port, wildcard/port-zero remote endpoint, and positive PID instead of relying on localized state words. The CLI still deduplicates PIDs before killing, while diagnostics keep listener address details.

## User Impact

Windows users with non-English system output get more reliable gateway port conflict detection, force-free cleanup, and diagnostics. Established TCP connections on the target port are not treated as listeners.

## Evidence

- Head SHA: `2beb4e06d4`
- Claim proved: localized Windows `netstat` listener rows are parsed by both CLI force-free and infra diagnostics paths without requiring English state text.
- Commands / artifacts:
  - `git diff --check`
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/cli/program.force.test.ts src/infra/ports.test.ts`
  - `OPENCLAW_OXLINT_SKIP_PREPARE=1 OPENCLAW_OXLINT_SKIP_LOCK=1 node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs src/cli/ports.ts src/cli/program.force.test.ts src/infra/ports-inspect.ts src/infra/ports-netstat.ts src/infra/ports.test.ts`
  - `node_modules/.bin/oxfmt.cmd --check --threads=1 src/cli/ports.ts src/cli/program.force.test.ts src/infra/ports-inspect.ts src/infra/ports-netstat.ts src/infra/ports.test.ts`
  - `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local`
- Observed result:
  - Vitest passed 2 shards: `src/infra/ports.test.ts` with 15 tests passed / 6 skipped, and `src/cli/program.force.test.ts` with 23 tests passed.
  - `git diff --check`, touched-file oxlint, and touched-file oxfmt check passed.
  - Autoreview exited 0 with no accepted/actionable findings.
- Not tested / proof gaps:
  - I did not run on a live localized Windows host; coverage is fixture-based against the Windows `netstat` output shape.
